pages.text: [#](53341a)A taglock is a thread of sympathy connecting a practitioner to their subject. Without one, poppets are merely decorative, curses fall without direction, and certain rites cannot find their target.[#]()
pages.title: Taglock Kit

pages.text: [#](53341a)Right-click a living creature directly, or steal a player's sample by crouching up behind them. Blood Poppies, Leech Chests, and a freshly slept-in bed can hold the same sample for later theft — guard your own sleep accordingly.[#]()
[#](53341a)A glass bottle and a pin. Simple, and deliberately so — the difficulty is in what you do with it afterward.[#]()
